key_claims: Oral administration of Zhinao Capsules (ZNC) improved abnormal sleep-wake distribution and cognitive performance in APP/PS1 mice.
ZNC treatment reduced cortical amyloid-beta immunoreactivity and glial reactivity while preserving dendritic architecture and restoring synaptic proteins.
ZNC administration increased hippocampal CX3CL1/CX3CR1-associated signaling and improved neuroimmune balance.
Recombinant CX3CL1 reproduced selected protective phenotypes in the experimental models.
BV2-specific Cx3cr1 knockdown modified inflammatory and synaptic responses while retaining partial ZNC-associated protection.
limitations: Surrogate marker measurements such as molecular signaling or cellular pathway assays do not measure tissue-specific botanical, anti-inflammatory, joint, enzymatic, or mucosal benefits.
The study was performed in murine models, which may not directly translate to human clinical outcomes.
Single-time-point UHPLC-HRMS plasma analysis was qualitative and did not establish pharmacokinetic parameters like half-life or maximum concentration at efficacy doses.
what_not_to_say: ZNC scores or surrogate biomarker changes measure tissue-specific botanical, anti-inflammatory, joint, enzymatic, or mucosal benefits.
ZNC provides definitive cures for Alzheimer's disease in human patients.
